Name: Foundation
Goal: Set up the Taskmoor repo, governance files, CI, clean-room protocol, architecture spikes, AI gateway design and an installable backend skeleton so later work is consistent and measurable
Main scope (modules): OPS; NFR; IAM; QRY; CORE; IMP; AI
Exit gate (automated): ADR-001 to ADR-032 Accepted; spikes meet budgets (query p95 < 300 ms and field edit p95 < 50 ms at 10M tickets; permission check p95 < 10 ms); tests pass locally on embedded Postgres and in CI on PostgreSQL 16; scans and nightly bench green; backend skeleton install < 10 min on 5 OS images; AI gateway contract tests green on mocks; counsel sign-off on clean-room protocol recorded; user acceptance
User inputs needed: Repo github.com/Rockersands/tracksmith created or access authorised (GitHub CLI not yet installed); Google Drive folder for docs and reports; benchmark runner and VM access; budget for Claude usage and CI; lane count and scheduled hours; licence confirmation; lawyer review of clean-room protocol

Name: Jira Software parity + DC-exit core (release 1.0)
Goal: Ship Taskmoor 1.0 as Builder-generated backend and frontend kits: Jira Software parity, query engine, native and Jira-compatible APIs, webhooks, MCP, enterprise identity and audit, AI gateway with first AI features, lossless DC and Cloud importer, backup and upgrades
Main scope (modules): CORE; WF; QRY; AGL; RPT; NTF; API; IMP; IAM; OPS (Builder, kits, install); NFR; AI (gateway and v1 features); TIM (time entries)
Exit gate (automated): Query conformance 100%; compat API suite 100% for in-scope endpoints; synthetic 1M-issue DC import >= 99.9% entity fidelity; query p95 < 300 ms at 1M tickets with 10M documented as an estimate (the user's decision of 2026-11-01); ticket open < 100 ms warm; Builder emits both kits; backend kit healthy on a fresh VM via install.sh; frontend zip on a static host at another origin passes full e2e with zero manual config; fresh VM to working app on a domain < 15 min; N-1 bundle still works; 3-minor upgrade with 0 manual steps; AI evals met and AI hidden with no key; axe 0 serious; 0 high/critical findings; user and design-partner acceptance
User inputs needed: Docker Desktop or a Linux VM/VPS before the install and cross-origin gates; test domain with DNS control and a plain static host; AI provider key or cloud account with a test spend cap; design partners or owner-supplied Jira exports; signing keys and container registry; security contact; lawyer review of compat shim and importer; translation reviewers; pen test vendor (recommended)

Name: Enterprise, automation and service-desk core (release 2.0)
Goal: Add automation, roadmaps, approvals, time tracking, hierarchy grid, scripting and WASM extensions, analytics/OData, dev-tool integrations, AI v2 and agents, HA, sandbox, BYOK, SIEM, a no-Docker single-binary backend and the service-desk core
Main scope (modules): AUT; PLN; TIM; EXT; RPT; DEV; AI; SD; KB; OPS; IAM; NFR; IMP; WF; CORE
Exit gate (automated): Automation and SLA suites 100%; roadmaps scheduler golden tests green; HA chaos test < 60 s recovery with 0 lost writes; WASM sandbox suite clean; OData conformance green; AI evals met and injection red-team shows 0 unauthorised writes; single-binary kit installs without Docker; perf budgets green at 30M tickets; pen test high/critical closed; user acceptance with a service-desk pilot
User inputs needed: Test tenants for email and code hosts; patent FTO review; pen test vendor; hosted-offering decision; optional local model host (GPU)

Name: ITSM, operations and CMDB (release 3.0)
Goal: Add incident, problem and change management, alerting and on-call with escalations and heartbeats, status pages, CMDB/Inventory, full knowledge base, virtual service agent and incident AI, mobile apps
Main scope (modules): ITSM; ONC; STS; CMDB; KB; AI; MOB; IAM; DEV; AUT; SD
Exit gate (automated): Alert-to-page p95 < 30 s via provider sandboxes; schedule and escalation suite incl. DST 100%; CMDB 1M-object query p95 < 500 ms; status page serves 10k rps from cache; mobile e2e green and store builds approved; chaos and restore drills pass; pen test findings closed; user acceptance with an on-call trial
User inputs needed: SMS and voice provider accounts; Apple and Google developer accounts; push credentials; SOC 2 auditor if a hosted service is offered; pen test vendor

Name: Discovery, portfolio, quality and ecosystem (release 4.0)
Goal: Close parity: Product Discovery equivalent with public idea portal, Align-style portfolio and SAFe, test management, OLAP reporting, whiteboards, customer service, extension registry, compliance builds
Main scope (modules): DSC; PRT; QA; RPT; NTF; SD; EXT; NFR; TIM; AI
Exit gate (automated): Traceability report: 100% of parity requirements covered by passing tests; test-management import fixtures green; OLAP budgets met; FIPS-mode build self-tests pass; registry rejects unsigned packages; user acceptance
User inputs needed: Compliance reviewer for FIPS and SSP packs; registry hosting; governance decision; acceptance time
